result.one_liner: Version control and collaboration platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for repository, issue, pull request, and workflow automation.

evidence.quote: you can create a personal access token, generate a token with a GitHub App, or use the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN
Add an Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer TOKEN (replace TOKEN with your GitHub personal access token)
If you want to use the GitHub REST API for personal use, you can create a personal access token
GitHub provides both REST and GraphQL APIs for accessing repository data and performing operations
Official GitHub MCP server implementation for Model Context Protocol

result.notes: GitHub offers free tier access with self-serve credentials for both REST and GraphQL APIs. REST API has hundreds of endpoints; GraphQL provides flexible query access to the same data. Personal access tokens and OAuth are primary documented methods. Free users can authenticate and make API calls with standard rate limits; higher limits available with paid accounts. Official GitHub MCP server enables AI-powered repository and workflow automation.
